gold.user: As a project manager, I want to retrieve the default columns for the issue navigator so that I can understand what information is displayed by default when viewing issues.
gold.ideal: The response should include a list of the default columns currently set for the issue navigator, allowing me to see which fields are visible by default.

gold.user: As a team lead, I want to update the default columns in the issue navigator to include additional fields that are relevant to my team's workflow, ensuring that we have quick access to the most important information.
gold.ideal: The request should successfully update the default columns and return a confirmation message indicating that the columns have been set, along with the new configuration.
